title: euphrasia slovaca
intro: Euphrasia slovaca, commonly known as the Slovak eyebright, is a plant species in the family Orobanchaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving eye health due to its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia slovaca are attributed to its ability to reduce swelling and pain in the eyes, as well as its antiseptic properties, which help to prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
